changelog: Free preset models now appear automatically in the Claude model picker: an OpenRouter provider is seeded with DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Gemini and free Gemma models at bridge start
If you already had an OpenRouter provider, the built-in presets are merged into it once (your API key and own models are kept)
OpenRouter can be saved without an API key so you can see the preset models first; add the key any time from Settings > Claude Code > Custom providers
Starting a chat on a provider without a key now shows a clear 'add the API key' error instead of a silent 401
Includes the 1.0.20 preset UI, 1.0.19 persistent signing fix, restored proot/loader binaries and hub startup/restart/CSRF fixes
